entities.name: Nemanja Gordić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nemanja Gordić is a Bosnian professional basketball player for Karşıyaka Basket of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). He also represents the senior Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team internationally. Gordić also holds Serbian citizenship.
